g.font-family: 'AriadneNSD Mono', D2Coding, Consolas, 'Malgun Gothic', 'Apple SD Gothic Neo', monospace
g.text: for (const { measure, x, y } of arrangement.placed)
box = { x: paper + x, y: paper + y, width, height: headHeight + bodyHeight }
body = { x: box.x, y: box.y + headHeight, width, height: bodyHeight }
return { width, height, diagrams, boxes, regions, nodes }
